description: This file provides a client for making API requests to a backend, including functions for health checks, listing users, sessions, deployments, and costs, with internal helpers for URL building, query parameter handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining a base URL with a relative path or returning absolute URLs as-is.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string from a parameters object, handling arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Checks if a URL path is the root of session-tracking collection.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on specific API endpoint rules.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include necessary scope identifiers like organization_id or tenant_id based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Merges existing URL query parameters with additional parameters and constructs the full URL.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning ok, status, and payload (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter sanitization, and response parsing.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON body, handling method, URL, parameters, and response.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses to include items, total, and meta.
